game: LV @ KC Week 7 2025, kickoff 2025-10-19 13:00 ET, Arrowhead outdoors, KC -13.5, total 44.5

script.base: Market script is KC 29.0, LV 15.5. KC leads by halftime and widens toward two scores; with LT Josh Simmons out, Mahomes builds it on quick throws (Kelce first) rather than a deep script, then the Pacheco/Hunt split drains the clock. LV trails and throws more into a 37% KC blitz that has already graded Geno at -0.19 EPA/db, so Jeanty's carries dip from his 19.3 per game weeks 4-6 while checkdowns rise.
script.flip1: LV hangs within a score into the fourth. Jeanty keeps a full carry share against a KC front allowing 4.90 YPC, Kelce plays the whole game, and both yardage overs get there together in something closer to 27-20 than 29-15.
script.flip2: KC is up 24-plus by half and the game dies. Mahomes and Kelce sit or go vanilla under 54.5, and the Raiders stall so completely (three-and-outs, not checkdown drives) that Jeanty finishes well under 74.5 rush+rec.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost because the base script was the burial, not the moderate lead. KC led 31-6 at half, Mahomes and Kelce were done after a 41-yard first half, and the Raiders never sustained a drive: Jeanty had a dozen empty touches and finished in the 50s while Mostert vultured the only chunk run. The soft 4.90 YPC and the middle YPA never got a sample. Separately, if LV had hung around, Kelce can still lose the way the 48-yard game already did if Worthy takes the explosives. The counter-case is strong enough to keep both at lean and off any blowout ticket.
slip_story: One story only: KC wins by about 10-17, not 24-plus, so Kelce is used while the lead is built and Jeanty still gets drives as LV chases. That is a moderate-lead stack, not a clock-kill stack and not a shootout. Do not pair either leg with a game under, a Jeanty rush-only under, or a KC deep-WR over that needs Simmons-out explosives. House rule: one market per player, no TDs.
